description: This file contains a Python module that defines the LiteLLMDatabase class for interfacing with a PostgreSQL database. It includes methods for retrieving usage data, schema information, and discovering database tables relevant to LiteLLM, indicating its role in database interaction and data extraction for the LiteLLM project.

classes.name: LiteLLMDatabase
classes.description: Handles database connections and queries for the LiteLLM system, including data retrieval, schema info, and table discovery.

methods.name: _ensure_prisma_client(self)
methods.description: Ensures the Prisma client is available for database operations, raising an exception if not connected.

methods.name: pl.DataFrame get_usage_data( self, limit: Optional[int] = None, start_time_utc: Optional[datetime] = None, end_time_utc: Optional[datetime] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves user usage statistics from the database with optional time filtering and limit.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_table_info(self)
methods.description: Fetches schema information and row count details for theLiteLLM_DailyUserSpend table.

methods.name: int _get_table_row_count(self, table_name: str)
methods.description: Gets the number of rows in a specified table.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] discover_all_tables(self)
methods.description: Discovers all tables related to LiteLLM, retrieving their schema details, indexes, primary and foreign keys, and row counts.
